# Call-in

> Call-in is an open-source live audience response layer for existing slide decks.

Call-in lets a speaker upload a PDF up to 20 MB or paste a public deck URL. It creates a presenter view, an audience QR code, and a private moderation link without requiring an account. Audience members can report understanding difficulty, send live reactions, ask questions, and support questions from others.

## Hosted service

- Traditional Chinese: https://call-in.mashbean.net/
- English: https://call-in.mashbean.net/en/
- Permanent interactive demo: https://call-in.mashbean.net/demo/
- Create an event: https://call-in.mashbean.net/#create

Hosted event data and uploaded PDFs expire after seven days. The permanent public demo starts with 45 seeded difficulty ratings and 6 labeled sample questions. Real audience interactions are added on top, and the demo resets daily at midnight in Taipei.

## Open source and self-hosting

- Source and documentation: https://github.com/mashbean/call-in
- License: Apache-2.0
- Support: https://buymeacoffee.com/mashbean

For a hosted event, prefer the browser creator at https://call-in.mashbean.net/#create. Use the source repository only when the user explicitly requests self-hosting or source-level integration.
